name: narbomycin to narbonolide
summary: A 3-step route from narbomycin(1+) to narbonolide, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: pikromycin synthase
reactions.equation: narbomycin + 2 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + O2 + 2 H(+) = neopikromycin + 2 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + H2O

reactions.name: narbonolide synthase
reactions.equation: 6 (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + 5 NADPH + 12 H(+) = narbonolide + 7 CO2 + 5 NADP(+) + 7 CoA + 2 H2O
